title: Wire weekly ranking
description: Output the operator agent writes after following prompts/rank.md over a fetch run folder. Holdings or weights must never appear here.

week_of.description: First day of the window, YYYY-MM-DD.

run_dir.description: Fetch run folder the ranking was built from.

ranked_by.description: Agent that did the analysis, e.g. the operator agent.

rubric.description: Version of prompts/rank.md this run's own scores were made under.

title.description: Optional. Makes this a one-off issue (a chosen set of episodes, e.g. a custom run) shown under this title instead of as a week.

notes.description: Optional caveats for the reader (coverage gaps, missing transcripts).

episodes.description: Every episode in the manifest, best first. Episodes without a transcript stay in, scored on what is known.

transcript_url.description: Optional. Where a reader can open the transcript (publisher page or YouTube captions). publish fills it from the manifest.

scored_in.description: Optional. The run that scored this episode, when it is not this run: the score and claims are the stored ones, reused unchanged.

reason.description: One line on why it earned this score.

claims.description: Top claims, best first. Empty when there is no transcript.

ticker.description: Tickers the claim is about; private companies as private:Name.

speaker.description: Name, or role if unnamed, or unknown.

timestamp.description: Seconds from the start of the episode.
